Terms of Service

Last updated: July 21, 2026

1. Service

LOBLY is a desktop companion matchmaking app for League of Legends. It helps players publish and join premade lobbies before queue. It does not provide information about matchmade opponents and does not assist queue dodging.

2. Accounts

You must provide a valid email and keep your credentials secure. Riot account linking uses the League client on your machine as ownership proof. You are responsible for activity on your LOBLY account.

3. Acceptable use

  • No harassment, hate speech, or bait joins.
  • No attempts to bypass filters, rate limits, or bans.
  • No scraping of the listing board or player profiles.

4. Third-party services

LOBLY uses Riot Games APIs and local League client services to provide account verification and lobby features. Riot Games' applicable terms also apply. League of Legends is a trademark of Riot Games; LOBLY is not endorsed by Riot Games.

5. Contact

Questions about these terms can be sent to support@lobly.gg.
